_comment: What the server decides for the launcher.
Each setting has a "value" (what the launcher starts with) and "enforce":
enforce false = the player can change it in the launcher
enforce true = the server's value is always used and the player's switch is greyed out
Leave a setting out to let the launcher use its own default. Any "_comment" is only a note: the launcher ignores it.

launcherUpdate._comment: A new launcher on the server: "required" installs it before the player can do anything else, "recommended" only shows a banner the player can put off. Left out: required.

installAddons._comment: Install and update the addons that come with the server (Interface/AddOns)

clearCache._comment: Empty the game's Cache folder before starting WoW (fixes old item and quest text after updates)

reopenAfterGame._comment: Open the launcher again when WoW closes

rememberWindow._comment: Remember where the launcher window was and how big it was

backupBeforeUpdate._comment: Back up the player's settings and addons (WTF, Interface) before every update

backupsToKeep._comment: How many of those backups to keep; the oldest are deleted first

largeAddressAware._comment: Let Wow.exe use up to 4 GB of memory instead of 2 GB (fewer out of memory crashes)

tweaks._comment: Game settings written into WTF/Config.wtf (dxvk.conf for the d3d9. and dxvk. ones). They fill the "Server recommended" preset on the Game settings page. Any CVar name works.

farclip._comment: How far land is drawn (game default 777, 1277 is the most)

maxFPS._comment: Highest frame rate while playing (0 = no limit)

cameraDistanceMax._comment: How far the camera zooms out (50 is the most)

nameplateDistance._comment: Awesome WotLK: nameplate range in yards (game default 41)

d3d9.samplerAnisotropy._comment: DXVK: sharper textures far away (-1 = the game's choice, up to 16)

dxvk.hud._comment: DXVK: "fps" shows the frame rate, empty shows nothing

defaultLocale._comment: The game language for new players (enUS if left out). Always installed. Add "requiredLocales": { "value": ["deDE"] } to install more languages for everyone.

news._comment: News page: show it or not, posts shown at first, and how many more each "Load more" adds (-1 = all)

downloadLimit._comment: The most KB/s each player may download at (0 or -1 = no cap). Players can still pick a lower limit.

theme._comment: temucraft, vanilla, tbc, wotlk, cata, mop, wod, legion, bfa, shadowlands, dragonflight, tww or midnight

reportBugUrl._comment: Where the bug icon next to Play sends players (it copies a report to paste there). Leave out for the launcher's GitHub issues.

realmStatusUrl._comment: The realm status over the news (online, players, peak, uptime): the website's ?realm-status=data. Leave out to use the NAV link of launcher.env named like Database (else the first) with ?realm-status=data; false hides it.

playerMapUrl._comment: The Player map link next to the realm status. Leave out to use the map address the website sends; false hides it.
